card.name: Start of advice sentence after a warning
card.fires_on: The first word of a new sentence right after a reported adverse event in a Warnings section, mostly "Patients" or "Prescribers" (split as Prescri-bers). Also "During" or "of" in monitoring advice.

modes.label: Patients opening a sentence
modes.description: The word "Patients" starts the sentence that follows a statement of a reported reaction.
modes.example: swelling of the throat and tongue.<< Patients>> should be instructed to discontinue VUM

modes.label: Prescribers partway through
modes.description: The ending of "Prescribers" at the start of a sentence giving instructions after a reported risk.
modes.example: Prescri<<bers>> should reassess patients for drowsiness

modes.label: Monitoring phrase words
modes.description: Small words inside monitoring advice, such as "of" after "monitoring" or "During" at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: Increased monitoring<< of>> heart rate and blood pressure may be appropriate

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese words meaning 'pay attention' and 'need to note', which suggests a caution or advice sentence is coming.
card.plain: It marks the point where a label moves from describing a side effect to telling patients or prescribers what to watch for.
